item.description: Service orchestration across the edge--cloud continuum increasingly uses language models (LMs) to translate intents and operational evidence into scheduling, configuration, diagnosis, and remediation decisions. item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in strategic decision-making, competitive positioning, innovation management, organizational learning, and governance, yet the literature remains fragmented across management, information systems, innovation, and technology-management fields. item.title: Making metacognition visible: AI-generated learning clues as signals of self-regulation and competence
item.description: Generative artificial intelligence makes knowledge instantly accessible, shifting the core educational value from what one knows to the ability to learn. This paper argues that metacognitive self-regulation, meaning the capacity to monitor, evaluate, and adjust one's own cognitive processes, is the foundational competence that AI cannot automate. item.description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) in education has increased the availability of personalized learning, intelligent tutoring, generative feedback, and automated instructional support.
